title: Choosing an EEG decoder from early calibration

conceptual_source: Choose CSP or a Riemannian decoder.
Compare on later trials at a fixed decision time.
source.exact_result_and_qualification: Selection did not beat fixed CSP at 60 calibration trials per session. This was a retrospective comparison using previously inspected later trials.
source.evaluation_question: Our team tested whether early EEG calibration data could select between common spatial patterns (CSP) and a Riemannian decoder.
source.scoring_distinction: The public account distinguishes the organisers’ peak-time score from the team’s fixed-time comparison. The figure depicts only the fixed-time comparison.

encoding.session_band: Categorical chronological sequence: early calibration then later trials. Segment widths and spacing are illustrative and encode no counts or duration.
encoding.fork: Calibration informs a choice between two decoder alternatives. It does not specify which decoder was chosen in any session.
encoding.green_solid_path: CSP decoder option, with redundant direct text label.
encoding.lilac_dashed_path: Riemannian decoder option, with redundant direct text label.
encoding.common_bracket: Both alternatives use the same fixed decision time in later-trial evaluation. The line is not a time axis.
encoding.reference: The chosen decoder is compared with fixed CSP.
encoding.result: Qualitative result at the single calibration count stated in the public account. No accuracy or effect size is inferred.

data: No empirical data, private files, EEG waveforms, trial-level values or invented quantitative outcomes were used.
font: Source Sans 3 with Arial and sans-serif fallbacks; lettering remains editable SVG text.
html_requirement: Retain the complete existing result and retrospective/previously-inspected qualification in HTML alongside the image. Keep detailed contribution and scoring-rule context in HTML.
limitations: The design schematic is not independent scientific validation and must never be described as blind, held-out, prospective or a live deployment result.
